mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 45 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, accompanied by a waxing crescent moon.

In city news, officers responded to a burglary in progress on the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10. A 19 year old man from Madison was taken into custody after a gunshot was reported, and a handgun was recovered at the scene.

Today you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow is a busy day with trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown Farmer's Market coming up this week.

On September 10, Verona police responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way where a 19 year old suspect was detained and charged with burglary and recklessly endangering safety after a firearm was discharged.
Culver's is closed for a scheduled remodel today, but the team will be ready to welcome you back when they open today at 10:00 AM.
